desc: A true competition 1911 that's ready for the battle against the timer. Now available in corrosion resistant Stainless Steel. Custom G10 Grips, Upswept Beavertail Grip Safety, and Undercut Trigger Guard keep the pistol low in the hand for increased control. The Dual Recoil spring system reduces felt recoil while extending recoil spring life. A National Match Barrel and Novak Adjustable Fiber Optic Sights help with precision shooting. The Series 70 Firing System ensures a clean crisp trigger pull.
